full_census.scope:
Independent, read-only census of retained PA files and recursively nested ZIPs.

Recognizes complete five-column numeric binary tables and explicit JSON arrays,
row records, paired/flat action lists and numeric or (state,read) dictionaries.
It does not execute generators or infer machines from mathematical prose.
notes: Every candidate file is read and checked against its pinned Git blob SHA.
Existing all-size catalogue identities may be reused only after exact table byte-hash agreement; new labeled identities are computed directly.
The separate portable novelty check reparses and recomputes every 194-state frontier graph independently.
Recognition requires exactly one external terminal target; no-terminal diagnostic graphs and one-state embedded JSON fragments are excluded.
Identical nested ZIP payloads are traversed once; archive aliases are recorded.
Nonspanning table_class values identify maximum reachable components, as in the repository index; use full_spanning_graph_classes for whole-graph counts.
